neighbours.label: Words of carrying on as before: ' still', ' continue', ' normally', ' normal', ' usual', 'the same level'; the same sentences with no such word stay low.
fire: Do you still drive that old truck?
Please continue to send your checks by mail.
To keep offering the same quality of food, we raised prices.
Keep taking the tablets daily until the course ends.
Cats need water to maintain normal kidney function.
Despite the storm, the trains ran normally.
Her visits continue on the first of the month.
It was back to work as usual on Monday.
quiet: Do you drive that old truck?
Please send your checks by mail.
To make better food, we raised prices.
Take the tablets with a meal.
Cats sat still by the water bowl.
During the storm, the trains ran late.
Her visits start on the first of the month.
It was back to work on Monday.

notes: Probes: 0.46-1.01 ('Continue to ask' 0.34 on '.'). Near misses 0.02-0.20. Peak token varies; ' regularly' 0.81 also fired. Words in the sentence are the test, so it isn't separated from the word list.
